install.defines: copy each listed .lua into the test mod's common/defines/ under its own basename (zz_* sorts after vanilla 00_*.lua and 01_*.lua)
install.shader_patches: apply the listed patch specs in list order (entries in file order) to the vanilla file named in 'file' (read from $HOI4_GAME_DIR) and ship the result at the same relative path in the test mod. offglobe_mask.patch.json only defines helpers (behaviour 'none') and always comes first.

variants.label: EXP-09a baseline
variants.changes: Baseline: nothing from P00c. Only P00b's off-globe filler (lake provinces, heightmap 89, ocean colormap tone). Vanilla camera defines (outside-map distance 200/200, max height 3000), vanilla shaders.

variants.label: EXP-09b camera edge limit
variants.changes: vs a: NGraphics.CAMERA_OUTSIDE_MAP_DISTANCE_TOP/BOTTOM 200 -> 15 (the 14.3-row off-globe margin rounded up), so the camera stops at the 90N pole line / 60S cut instead of drifting ~186 rows into empty space.

variants.label: EXP-09c edge limit + max height
variants.changes: vs b: adds NFrontend.CAMERA_MAX_HEIGHT 3000 -> 2400 (first calibration point; less empty space above/below the map at full zoom-out, at the cost of a smaller overview). Everything else as b.

variants.label: EXP-09d c + off-globe ice suppression
variants.changes: vs c: one shader behaviour in gfx/FX/pdxwater.shader - no winter sea ice on water outside the Equal Earth outline (8-px band). The outline is computed analytically in the shader (helpers in offglobe_mask, no visible effect of their own) and only on a 5120x2304 map. Nothing else changes: no darkening, no geometry, no picking change. Compare with c in screenshot 6.

variants.label: EXP-09e d + far-zoom off-globe darkening
variants.changes: vs d: one more shader behaviour - water outside the Equal Earth outline darkens to 45 % of its own colour over a 40-px band, fading in with camera height 400 -> 1500 (no effect when zoomed in). Compare with d in screenshots 1-3 and 7.
